_comment: Single source of truth for all scripts. Boxes placed from ESA WorldCover 2021 coastline + published coordinates of each named site (500 m boxes, shifted 80 m seaward so the coast sits mid-box). box = [lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max] WGS84. type: beach | modified | rock (rock = never tide-corrected, no SAR). role: target | control. slope = tan(beta) for tidal correction (0.06 placeholder; replace with CoastSat.slope). break_year: 'auto' screens for an abrupt change, a year fixes it, null skips. start_year: drop scenes before this year (decide after the first run from results/<site>/scenes_per_year.csv). s1: filled by 00_data_inventory.py (orbit with most scenes); 'auto' lets 04 pick it itself. ee_project: your Google Cloud project with Earth Engine enabled (the ONLY value you must edit before running).

tha_yai_thim.note: south tip; low-tide sand bar ('thale waek') - tide correction matters

hin_muat_sila.note: rocky/gravel beach; Novotel construction began 2017-2018 (Google Earth 4/2017 vs 11/2018)

tha_wang.note: Phra Chudadhut palace frontage, Atsadang bridge

laem_ngu.note: headland next to the green pier (saphan khiao)

town_harbour.note: AUTO-PLACED on densest coastal built-up (main town/piers) - confirm

chong_khao_khat.note: eroding rock slope, west coast - cliff-retreat target, not a control

rock_control.note: AUTO-PLACED undeveloped forested cliff, NW lobe - precision control, confirm
